name: GiveTap
shortDescription: A UK service for online and contactless donations, including QR-code, card-terminal and tap-to-pay options. It has donation pages, reports and supplier-described Gift Aid settings.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking contactless, QR and website donation routes
Fundraising teams that need reusable campaigns and individual supporter collection
Events or services where a phone-based contactless donation option would reduce hardware needs

pricing.summary: GiveTap publishes a 2.5% plus VAT platform fee for the card-reader rental offer, alongside Stripe's stated 1.5% + 10p in-person processing fee. It also advertises a £2 monthly fee for its Stripe S700 option when there is at least one transaction. Request current pricing for the church's chosen devices, online donations, Gift Aid workflow and payment provider.

tiers.label: Card-reader rental
tiers.price: £10/week for Stripe BBPOS WisePad 3 or £25/week for Stripe S700
tiers.detail: Supplier says a 2.5% + VAT GiveTap platform fee and Stripe processing fee apply

tiers.label: Stripe S700 option
tiers.price: £2/month when there is at least one transaction
tiers.detail: Supplier states standard processing fees are additional

dataHosting: GiveTap's published privacy notice says data is stored on encrypted European servers. Ask for the current subprocessor list, precise hosting locations, retention settings, security documentation and current data-processing agreement before use.
gdprInformation: The supplier's privacy notice distinguishes its controller role for its marketing site from its processor role for a charity customer's platform use. This is supplier documentation, not an assessment of a church's compliance or privacy notice.
coreFeatures: Website donation pages and embeddable donation-button route
Tap-to-pay donations on compatible iPhone and Android devices
Supplier-described Gift Aid configuration and HMRC integration
integrations: Square for relevant charity payment flows according to the supplier privacy notice
Apple Pay and Google Pay on website-donation pages according to the supplier
importExport: Supplier states dashboard donation reports can be exported
Its terms say a client can arrange a transfer of client information, such as donation reports, before cancellation
Test the report fields, Gift Aid records and export format with real sample data before committing
support: Supplier publishes demo, email and help-centre routes
Current support response and onboarding scope should be agreed before purchase

uk-purchasing.value: GiveTap Limited is an active England-and-Wales private limited company, number 12166824.

cashless-giving.value: Supplier documents website donation pages, QR/NFC giving, card readers and phone-based contactless donations.

published-fee-example.value: Supplier publishes a 2.5% + VAT platform fee and a 1.5% + 10p Stripe in-person processing example for its card-reader rental offer.

data-and-exit.value: Supplier privacy notice describes its charity-platform processor role and encrypted European servers; published terms describe cancellation and a pre-cancellation information-transfer arrangement.

editorial.assessment: GiveTap is a credible UK option when a church needs more than a single website donation button: it combines online pages with QR, NFC, portable card readers and phone-based contactless collection. Its cost depends on the route used, so compare the platform fee, payment-processing fee, hardware charge and VAT across the church's real mix of gifts. The supplier describes Gift Aid configuration and HMRC integration, but the church remains responsible for its declarations, eligibility and claims process.
bestFor: Churches adding contactless giving to services, events and community fundraising
Teams wanting QR/NFC and web donation journeys alongside physical collection points
Fundraising teams that want supporters to collect contactless donations through their own compatible phones
strengths: Active UK company with published privacy notice and platform terms
Broad online and in-person cashless donation routes
Published device-rental and fee examples, plus report-export and cancellation information
limitations: Current public examples do not provide a complete pricing schedule for every online, terminal and Gift Aid use case
Supplier privacy notice says data is stored in Europe rather than identifying UK-only hosting
Device compatibility, signal resilience, payment-provider terms and supporter-fee presentation need practical testing
